name: Skipper Whistle
shortDescription: A landing whistle on a wet cord.
examineDescription: A river whistle of turned bone on a fresh cord, the mouthpiece worn smooth and shallow. It has hung on a nail at the heron post for eleven years and the note carries the whole way up the bank to the landing. Midge put it in your paw rather than back on the nail, and she will want it back there before dark.
